links.note: Design for open idea IDEA-20261029-3d0e71; not yet approved or dispatched.

question: For p with d=2^k dividing p-1 and at least five usable distinct x, does a shared-coefficient Graeffe tower reduce complete five-point decomposition work by 2x against per-root PKM, symmetric S6 and quotient towers on three matched cells?

claims.text: Exact model agreement is required on identical squarefree charts before any timing; a missing or spurious relation invalidates the arm.
After matching permutation multiplicity and root sets, the Graeffe arm's complete relation cost is at least 2x lower on three matched k=3,4 cells.
claims.if_supported: the claim holds within the frozen cells and instrument named here
claims.if_not_supported: the claim is refuted within the frozen cells; report the direction and effect

hypotheses.statement: A shared divisor-coefficient Graeffe membership tower cuts complete five-point decomposition work by 2x relative to per-root PKM towers, without a degree or exponent claim.
hypotheses.mechanism: Sharing the coefficient tower across roots moves repeated membership work into one Graeffe evaluation; if the correspondence holds, the complete cost falls even though the intrinsic degree does not.

arms.description: per-root PKM with a second root ordering
a planted five-point relation the tower must recover exactly
k=2 empty-chart control, where no usable five-point chart exists

positive.expected_detection: the planted relation is recovered exactly

null_population.description: k=2 empty-chart cells where no five-point decomposition exists
null_population.generator: k=2 empty-chart cells where no five-point decomposition exists
null_population.why_n: enough independent null draws to resolve the stated alpha under the family correction; the null is exact where the proposal states an exact count, and sampled otherwise

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: one pinned build and binary per arm

factors.name: instance
factors.value: frozen inputs named in the proposal

factors.name: host_load
factors.how: recorded per row; affects only wall time, which is not primary

factors.name: tower
factors.how: per-root PKM, symmetric S6, quotient, Graeffe

factors.name: cell
factors.value: k=3,4 cells with at least five usable distinct x

comparisons.threshold: cost ratio <=0.5 on three matched cells with exact model agreement

seed_derivation.note: seeds derived from the frozen protocol hash, arm, instance and replicate

instance_sampling.rule: instances fixed by the frozen proposal and independent of arm

blinding.how: arm labels masked until the analysis script is frozen and has run

power.note: 2/(N+1) resolution bound; test-specific power is argued in the proposal's minimum-effect row

preflight_runtime.measured_on: estimate from the proposal's stated cell sizes; no run yet

primary.name: complete relation cost
primary.definition: setup, tower, membership and verification per verified relation

primary.name: chart coverage
primary.definition: squarefree charts covered by the census

stopping_rules.rule: fixed: three matched cells x four towers; exact model agreement first, timing second; k=2 negative control; then stop

invalidation_rules: a row whose instrument hash differs from the frozen build is excluded and reported
a control that fails its expected detection voids the clean cells it was meant to protect

decision_rule.text: C-gain is supported when complete relation cost is at most 0.5x per-root PKM on three matched cells after matching permutation multiplicity and root sets, with exact model agreement; any missing or spurious relation, or a gain that is only a permutation constant, refutes it.
decision_rule.threshold: cost ratio <=0.5 on three matched cells with exact model agreement
decision_rule.statistic: the primary metric named in C2, pooled as the proposal specifies
decision_rule.interval: Clopper-Pearson or bootstrap 95% as the metric states

inadmissible: reading a permutation-constant gain as a cost gain
claiming a degree or exponent improvement
